'''DecipherCon 1999 Players Choice''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). [[Rick Gaudioso]] won the Saturday heat, out of 31 players over 3 games.<ref name="dc99sw21_3">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW21_3.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Players Choice], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001219114400/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW21_3.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Side event (Players' Choice Sealed Deck)
* '''Format:''' [[Players' Choice Sealed Deck]]<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sat">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Saturday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026023004/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sat_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' Thursday 11 November 1999, 10 p.m.–4 a.m.; Friday 12 November 1999, 8 a.m.–2 p.m.; Saturday 13 November 1999, 9 p.m.–3 a.m.
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia
* '''Players:''' 31 (Saturday heat); 36 (Thursday heat)<ref name="cec-dc1">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon1.html DeciperCon '99 Report No.1], Ryan Patterson, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030053/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/decipercon1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Score sheets for the Thursday and Friday heats are not preserved.<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Tim Guzman]] was tournament director of the Friday-morning Star Wars CCG heat. Each player received an OTSD and four booster packs of the expansion or expansions of their choice, chosen before they knew which side they would play. Guzman said players went for A New Hope and stayed away from Dagobah. [[Francis Lalumiere|Francis K. Lalumiere]] reported that only one player tried Cloud City.<ref name="erb-wisely">[http://calder.decipher.com/cgi-bin/msgbd?dconerb$3613-10753$1 "Choose Wisely"], Francis K. Lalumiere, DecipherCon: Event Report Board, Decipher (12 November 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001024195154/http://calder.decipher.com:80/cgi-bin/msgbd?dconerb$3613-10753$1 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Thursday heat ==

[[Ryan Patterson]] and [[Phillip Chapman]] (written "Phil Champman") ran the Thursday-night heat, which began at 10 p.m. and ended at 4 a.m. It had 36 players and [[John Patelle]] won.<ref name="cec-dc1" />
